meta.title: ClipsFlow — Turn long videos into Shorts
meta.description: Create Shorts from 1-minute to 4-hour videos and podcasts. Review AI-selected moments, add synchronized captions and motion design, then download or prepare a confirmed YouTube upload.

home.hero_part1: Turn long videos and podcasts into
home.subtitle: Import a 1-minute to 4-hour video or podcast. AI transcribes the source and ranks the best moments around your instructions, then prepares captioned Shorts for your review before rendering or a private YouTube upload you confirm.
home.social_proof: 1 minute–4 hours · Audio-only or audio + video · YouTube uploads always require your confirmation
home.preview_alt: ClipsFlow Shorts Studio preview showing suggested moments, transcript, audio timeline, and vertical production preview.
home.features_subtitle: From full-length source analysis to a reviewed, ready-to-publish Short.
home.feature_shorts_desc: Import a 1-minute to 4-hour video or podcast. The AI transcribes the full source, analyzes audio or audio plus video, then ranks the strongest excerpts around your guidance.
home.feature_clips_desc: Shorts, Reels and TikTok clips with burned-in subtitles in 15 styles — ready to post.
home.feature_dub_desc: Word-by-word animated captions in 15 styles, custom colors, fonts and positions.
home.feature_consent_desc: 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9 — pick a preset, generate, download MP4 + VTT.
home.step1_desc: Bring in a video or podcast, then choose audio-only analysis or audio plus video when you want visual context.
home.step2_title: Review the transcript and best moments
home.step2_desc: ClipsFlow transcribes the source with timestamps, ranks candidate excerpts, and uses your instructions to guide the selection. You decide which moments to produce.
home.step3_title: Create, download, and publish with control
home.step3_desc: Render synchronized subtitles and motion-design templates. Adapted instrumental music is generated with ElevenLabs only after consent and rights confirmation. Download Shorts individually or in a ZIP; every YouTube upload requires your confirmation and starts private.
home.pricing_subtitle: All plans include AI subtitles, vertical formats, and direct downloads. No hidden fees.
home.faq_q1_answer: Shorts Studio accepts video and podcast sources from 1 minute to 4 hours; choose audio-only analysis for a podcast or audio plus video for visual context. The classic Clips import is a separate workflow and remains limited to 200 MB per file.
home.faq_q2_title: How does the AI subtitle generation work?
home.faq_q2_answer: ClipsFlow transcribes the complete source with word-level timestamps, then analyzes transcript context and, when selected, video frames to rank candidate moments. Review the transcript excerpts and select the Shorts you want before rendering.
home.faq_q3_title: Is the free plan really free?
home.faq_q3_answer: Yes. Free tier includes 60 seconds of rendered clips per month, with a ClipsFlow watermark. Solo, Pro, and Studio plans remove the watermark and unlock more styles.
home.faq_q4_answer: Absolutely. No contracts, no minimum commitment. Cancel from your Stripe dashboard and you keep access until the end of your billing period.
home.final_title: Your next episode can become a batch of Shorts
home.final_subtitle: Choose the strongest moments, review them, and render only the Shorts you want. Download individually or together, then prepare a YouTube upload for your own confirmation.
home.footer_text: © 2026 ClipsFlow. Built for creators who ship.
